```{r}
quad_data <- readRDS('Data/quad_data.rds') %>%
  mutate(Region = factor(Region, levels = c('Head','Body','Tail')),
         Sex = factor(Sex, levels = c('Female','Male')),
         Diagnosis = factor(Diagnosis, levels = c('ND','T1D')),
         Donor = factor(Donor), ImageID = factor(ImageID)) 

names(quad_data)

# 1. One mean β-cell % per donor — unweighted mean of that donor's islets,
#    matching the per-donor points in Fig 7E.
donor_beta <- quad_data %>%
  group_by(Diagnosis, Donor) %>%
  summarise(beta_pct = mean(Percent.ins, na.rm = TRUE),
            n_islets = n(),
            .groups  = "drop")

# 2. ND reference interval, built from the ND donor means.
nd <- donor_beta %>% filter(Diagnosis == "ND") %>% pull(beta_pct)

nd_ref <- list(
  mean   = mean(nd),
  ci95   = mean(nd) + c(-1, 1) * qt(.975, length(nd) - 1) * sd(nd) / sqrt(length(nd)), # 95% CI of the ND mean (your stated choice)
  pctl95 = quantile(nd, c(.025, .975)),   # central 95% of the ND donor spread
  range  = range(nd)                      # full observed ND range
)
nd_ref

# 3. Count the T1D donors that reach the ND range.
t1d <- donor_beta %>% filter(Diagnosis == "T1D")

lower_bound <- nd_ref$ci95[1]             # bottom of the ND mean's 95% CI

t1d_in_range <- t1d %>% filter(beta_pct >= lower_bound)   # "at or above the bottom of the ND range"
# strictly inside instead:  filter(beta_pct >= nd_ref$ci95[1] & beta_pct <= nd_ref$ci95[2])

nrow(t1d_in_range)   # -> the N for "[N] of XX T1D donors"
nrow(t1d)            # -> denominator (settles 34 vs 35)
lapply(nd_ref, function(x) round(x * 100, 1))   # ND reference in %
print(t1d_in_range %>% mutate(beta_pct = round(beta_pct * 100, 1)))

print(t1d %>%
  left_join(
    quad_data %>% group_by(Donor) %>%
      summarise(Disease.Duration = first(Disease.Duration),
                age_at_onset = first(age_at_onset), .groups = "drop"),
    by = "Donor") %>%
  arrange(desc(beta_pct)) %>%
  mutate(in_ND_range = beta_pct >= lower_bound))
```
